title: size_t→word32 cast without guard in peer_pub_len (hsm_derive + soft_derive)
description: In both hsm_derive (wp11_backend_wolfhsm.c) and soft_derive (wp11_backend_soft.c), peer_pub_len (size_t) is cast directly to word32 when calling wc_ecc_import_x963 with no bounds check. On a 64-bit system, a caller passing peer_pub_len > UINT32_MAX would silently truncate the length. The fix is a guard: if (peer_pub_len > (size_t)UINT32_MAX) return -1; before each cast. In practice, no real EC point exceeds ~133 bytes (P-521 uncompressed), so this is defensive-but-correct, not currently exploitable via normal PKCS#11 paths.
